content:
Rina: Quick heads-up — between 02:45-02:58 UTC we saw a spike in failed onboarding item writes for a small percentage of tenants. Collecting affected list now. Marco can you triage renewals and draft comms?

SRE-Ju: Confirmed. Root cause appears to be a malformed rollout of a throttling config which caused transient write rejections for larger payloads. We reverted the config at 02:52 UTC and kicked a priority requeue. Queue is currently draining; success rate on retries ~97%.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-271. requeue job started: rjob-4245678901.

Marco (CS): Thanks Ju. Early affected preview: OnboardTrial-7, RetailNorth-12 (renewal in 8 days), CampusPilot-6. I'll mark RetailNorth-12 high-touch. Rina — can you share renewal contact?

Abe (AE): RetailNorth-12 is critical. Please include an elevated remediation: 1 month premium support or a 25% billing credit + named AE/SRE sync. I'll join the outreach.

Marco (CS): Draft standard outbound (compact):
"Hi <Name>, we observed brief delays processing uploads between 02:45-02:58 UTC that may have prevented some uploads from completing. We reverted a recent internal change and retried pending items; most customers will see processing finish within the hour. We're sorry for the disruption — we'd like to offer a complimentary 60-minute recovery session and a one-time 5% credit. If you still see missing items reply and we'll prioritize a manual re-ingest. Office hours: Mon 10am PT / Wed 4pm CET / Fri 9am IST."

Marco (CS): Draft high-touch outbound (RetailNorth-12):
"Hi <Name>, apologies for the interruption earlier today. We've prioritized your uploads and retried pending items. To ensure continuity around your renewal we'd like to offer one month of premium support at no charge, a 30-minute technical sync with our SRE (Ju) and AE (Abe), and a one-time billing credit. Reply with a preferred time and we'll schedule immediately. For finance tracking please include tag: incident-credit-4245678901."

SRE-Ju: For external comms avoid internal jargon — suggest wording: "we reverted an internal configuration change and reprocessed your uploads." Internally: action items — add canary for throttling config flips, add payload-size shadow testing, and improve rollback automation.

Rina: Good. Marco — can you segment the affected customers into renewal-window vs trial and send high-touch to renewals in the next 10m? Also create a CS tracker entry and include a booking link for office hours.

Marco (CS): Will do. CS tracker created and RetailNorth-12 flagged high-risk. Posting high-touch message now and broadcasting standard template to trials in 20m after queue confirms drain.

Abe (AE): DMing Marco the specific concession language for RetailNorth-12 and asking to be CC'd. Also request a direct phone/SMS line included for that account.

ops-bot: confluence placeholder: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-271/summary. Incident channel: #inc-271-ops.

Marco (CS): Noted. I'll include a simple FAQ line in the outbound: "What happened? We reverted an internal change and reprocessed uploads." and a clear CTA: "Reply to this message if you need manual re-ingest or immediate help."

SRE-Ju: Queue at 88% drained. Will attach retry logs and a short technical note to the incident doc. Also recommending a new smoke test that replays a handful of real uploads after throttling-related config changes.

Rina: Plan: 1) High-touch outreach to renewal accounts now. 2) Broadcast standard template to trials in 20m. 3) Open two recovery office-hours slots and capture feedback for the RCA. Update execs with a 3-line summary by EOD.

Marco (CS): Sending now. Will log customer replies in the tracker and escalate any request for manual re-ingest. :thumbsup:

Abe (AE): I'll join the RetailNorth-12 sync and follow up with a renewal assurance note. Thanks team.

ops-bot: incident follow-ups: postmortem pending; RCA link will be updated in the confluence doc when ready.
